changelog: Added Mini Apps: AntiGem is now a super-app platform — lightweight web apps live in ~/mini-apps/<app-name>/ and open full-screen in a zero-server native container (no HTTP server, instant boot)

Mini Apps get a native bridge: atomic per-account storage mirrored to ~/antigem-data/mini-apps/<app>/<account>/data.json, local MCP tool calls, account identity and live hot reload when the AI agent edits files

Added a Mini Apps drawer (grid icon in the sidebar) listing every installed app with its icon, plus a bundled sample app (Achiva Study OS) that demonstrates storage, tasks and focus timer out of the box
